title: lab2rgb
summary: Convert CIE L*a*b* values to sRGB using MATLAB-compatible D65 conversion defaults.

gpu_support.notes: Host implementation uses the default D65/sRGB conversion path. Floating output retains out-of-gamut values; integer OutputType clips during class conversion.

description: `lab2rgb(LAB)` converts single or double L*a*b* image or colormap data to sRGB values under D65 assumptions. `OutputType` selects double, single, uint8, or uint16 output.
behaviors: Accepts MxNx3 Lab images and Nx3 Lab colormaps.
Floating output preserves out-of-gamut RGB values; uint8 and uint16 output clips to [0,1] while converting to native integer storage.
The OutputType name-value option accepts double, single, uint8, or uint16.

examples.output: % RGB has red, green, and blue channels
